data.why: The web app generates its own synthetic 500-spot/500-gene demo AnnData in-process (generate_demo_data in webapp/app.py) and also accepts uploaded .h5ad files; no bundled example .h5ad exists in the repo to copy as an upload, so the built-in Demo Data radio button is the primary path.

goals: Run the full secretion-diffusion-receptor pipeline on the built-in demo spatial dataset and identify the top metabolite-receptor interactions ranked by interaction score and Moran's I spatial autocorrelation
Tune diffusion model parameters (FFT vs finite-difference solver, pixel size, diffusion coefficient context) and see how predicted metabolite concentration maps change
Assess statistical significance of candidate metabolite-mediated communication events via permutation testing and FDR-style p-values
Deconvolve spots into cell types (NNLS) and build a cell-type-level cell-cell communication network, identifying communication hub cell types
Compare metabolite secretion-rate maps against diffused concentration maps for a chosen metabolite to see spatial smoothing effects
Export interaction and hub-cell-type tables as CSV for downstream analysis

review.summary: The goal statement, the settings phase and the paired source-vs-spread map viewer are accurate and well evidenced. Every screenshot I opened matched its node. But this run happened to get 0 interactions on a demo that differs between server restarts, so the tree leaves out the interaction table, significance results, communication network and CSV export, which are the core of what the tool is for, and it presents one run's numbers as if they were fixed.
